title: The Emperor's Secret Letter
synopsis: The Emperor's secret letter is hidden.
Watchers at every gate. It must leave unseen.
goal: Find the hidden letter, take it out unseen, and give it to the envoy Yi Jun.

notes: Traces read (DeductionScene): footprints off the path toward the trees, a yellow silk thread on bark, moss pushed aside by a root all point to the old pine's hollow.

Measured 2026-11-06 on the grid sheet of c06_palace_garden.webp (picture.measuredOn): the stone lantern on the left, the garden gate, the old pine with its hollow on the right of centre, the three pots by the steps; the marks (footprints off the path, the thread on the low branch, the moss by the roots) are where the game draws them; no two areas overlap.
The traces may be drawn by the app over their areas; the picture holds no writing.
Puzzle kind chosen by hand: the season spread assigns Case 06 a trace deduction (PART 10 brief); Bongsu's note is the list of traces, each a line of it.

objectives: Show Yi Jun no one saw it.
intro: In 1897, Gojong became Emperor. He wanted Korea free.
In 1905, Japan forced a treaty on Korea. Korea lost the right to deal with other countries.
Many countries meet at The Hague.
He will send three men in secret.
But watchers are at every gate.
play.caseSummary: Bongsu's note led to the Emperor's letter in the old pine. It left by the little west gate. You knocked on Yi Jun's door at 6:50, between the watchers' walks. The thread, the way and the times showed Yi Jun that no one saw it. In 1907 three envoys went to The Hague. They went to tell the world the 1905 treaty was forced. They were not let into the conference. Yi Jun died in The Hague. Japan used the envoys as an excuse to force the Emperor off his throne.
